title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
description: Anthropic released new Claude Mythos and Fable models, with coverage noting concerns about recursive self-improvement. The release comes as the company prepares for its IPO.

title: Anthropic releases first frontier models since Amodei's call for slowdown as IPO buzz builds
description: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on Monday, its first frontier models since CEO Dario Amodei called for a slowdown. Fable 5.2 is priced below GPT-6 Astra, and the IPO could come as soon as next week.

title: Google advances agentic AI custom silicon, expanding TPU family with 8tx and 8i Max
description: Google introduced two new chips in its eighth-generation TPU family, the TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, aimed at agentic AI workloads. The additions expand its custom silicon lineup for training and inference.

title: Meta introduces Muse Ember to power cost-efficient AI agents
description: Meta released Muse Ember, a model designed for cost-efficient AI agents. Meta says it matches the score of Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 at about a third of the price.

title: OpenAI reportedly raises $11B in new funding at $1.25T valuation
description: OpenAI has reportedly raised $11 billion in a round that could nearly double in size over coming weeks, valuing it at $1.25 trillion. The company is reported to plan a public listing in 2027.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, an Astra model built to keep vulnerability research in scope
description: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a variant of GPT-6 Astra tuned for security work such as vulnerability research. It is reported to outperform Astra on most cybersecurity tasks.

title: Google, Anthropic and others to support new AI crawling opt-out standard
description: Google, Anthropic, OpenAI and Microsoft plan to support a new standard that lets site operators block all generative-AI training scrapers with a single robots.txt entry. The move could simplify content opt-outs across major AI vendors.
